lookback_notes: Audit area 28 states no observation/look-back window. The document does state a 7-day on-site look-back period, but only in a separate audit area (30. state_deltas.delta: This is a New York State (OMIG) audit protocol for the Assisted Living Program; audit area 28 requires that the PRI applicable to the claim be dated and signed by a qualified assessor, or the claim is disallowed.

Regulatory references cited for this finding: 10 NYCRR § 86-2.30(c); 10 NYCRR § 766.6(a)(3); 18 NYCRR § 504.3(i); DOH Hospital and Community PRI Instructions, Specialized Services, Paragraph 35; NYS DOH DAL HCBS 08-02; For Services 05/25/18 and After: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(h); For Services 03/17/93 through 05/24/18: 18 NYCRR § 494.4(g).
